data.title: Tiler
data.summary: The role covers full wet-room renovations, from protection and demolition to waterproofing, tiling, installations and finishing. Work takes place at changing sites.

requirements.text: Experience in tiling and waterproofing work
Ability to work independently and systematically
requirements.question: What does 'independent and systematic work' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for independent and systematic work without describing what this involves.

requirements.question: What does 'careful workmanship' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for careful workmanship without giving a concrete quality standard.

requirements.question: What does 'good problem-solving skills' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting requests problem-solving skills but does not describe the problems typically encountered.

requirements.question: What does 'customer-service-oriented attitude' look like in this job? One concrete example helps us find people who have done it.
requirements.why: The posting asks for a customer-service-oriented attitude without describing the expected interactions.

requirements.text: Access to a car for travel between changing work sites
Good spoken and comprehension skills in Finnish
requirements.question: Is Finnish needed from day one, or could someone start in English and build up Finnish on the job?
requirements.why: The posting requires strong spoken Finnish and good comprehension of the language.
